bounds.domain: One direct file open, one native grant, and at most two Files visits.
bounds.abstraction: View commit, access and selection are independent receipts. The actual host and storage decide when each settles.
bounds.limits: Native permissions, concurrent agent operations, filtering, mutations, storage bytes, renderer layout and recovery are outside this model.
bounds.conformance: Actual shared runner exercises cold commit, a held first reload and cancellation with a delayed grant over controlled host and storage ports.

assumptions: No fairness. The renderer and the open action do not share a storage-read ticket.
No fairness. If a retired selection returns a grant, the runner sends a release request.
Weak fairness of the outstanding view or storage receipt. The receipt can fail. There is no wall-clock completion guarantee.
